+"""Append archived Vendor Exact skin maps to an engineering-debug DOCX only."""
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import json
+import shutil
+import zipfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from docx import Document
+from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
+from docx.shared import Inches
+
+
+VENDOR_IMAGES = (
+    (
+        "BROWN_M.jpg",
+        "厂家原生 Brown 综合色素图",
+        "综合色素增强显示；由厂家 /generate 直接输出。",
+    ),
+    (
+        "RED_M.jpg",
+        "厂家原生 Red 红区图",
+        "红区增强显示；由厂家 /generate 直接输出。",
+    ),
+    (
+        "REDNE_M.jpg",
+        "厂家原生 RedNE 红褐联合图",
+        "红褐联合增强显示；由厂家 /generate 直接输出。",
+    ),
+)
+
+
+def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as stream:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def _bounded_image(root: Path, filename: str) -> Path:
+    source_root = root.resolve(strict=True)
+    path = (source_root / filename).resolve(strict=True)
+    if not path.is_relative_to(source_root) or path.is_symlink():
+        raise ValueError(f"vendor image escaped the fixed root: {filename}")
+    if not path.is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(path)
+    return path
+
+
+def _docx_text(path: Path) -> str:
+    document = Document(path)
+    return "\n".join(paragraph.text for paragraph in document.paragraphs) + "\n" + "\n".join(
+        cell.text
+        for table in document.tables
+        for row in table.rows
+        for cell in row.cells
+    )
+
+
+def _embedded_media_hashes(path: Path) -> set[str]:
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
+        return {
+            hashlib.sha256(archive.read(name)).hexdigest()
+            for name in archive.namelist()
+            if name.startswith("word/media/")
+        }
+
+
+def build_debug_report(
+    source_debug: Path,
+    vendor_root: Path,
+    output_root: Path,
+) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
+    source_debug = source_debug.resolve(strict=True)
+    if source_debug.suffix.lower() != ".docx":
+        raise ValueError("source debug report must be a DOCX")
+    if output_root.exists():
+        raise FileExistsError(output_root)
+    output_root.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)
+
+    staged_root = output_root / "vendor_exact_raw"
+    staged_root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
+    staged: list[tuple[Path, str, str]] = []
+    try:
+        for filename, caption, explanation in VENDOR_IMAGES:
+            source = _bounded_image(vendor_root, filename)
+            target = staged_root / filename
+            shutil.copyfile(source, target)
+            if _sha256(source) != _sha256(target):
+                raise RuntimeError(f"vendor image copy hash mismatch: {filename}")
+            staged.append((target, caption, explanation))
+
+        output_docx = output_root / "AISIA_clinic28-25_工程调试报告_厂家原生红棕对照.docx"
+        document = Document(source_debug)
+        original_shapes = len(document.inline_shapes)
+        document.add_page_break()
+        document.add_heading("厂家原生红棕增强图（调试对照）", level=1)
+        document.add_paragraph(
+            "以下图像为同一仪器采集会话中已保存的厂家 /generate 原生成品。"
+            "厂家输入为 RGB、CP、365 三种通道的 L/M/R 九张图；PP 不参与该接口。"
+        )
+        document.add_paragraph(
+            "本节未运行 DermaVision 检测器，未使用我们的 Mask、score map、ROI 或调色器。"
+            "仅用于调试视觉对照，不进入用户正式版或医生正式版。"
+        )
+        document.add_paragraph(
+            "finding_backend=vendor_multispectral_exact_archived；license_status=unknown。"
+        )
+        for path, caption, explanation in staged:
+            document.add_heading(caption, level=2)
+            document.add_paragraph(explanation)
+            picture = document.add_paragraph()
+            picture.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
+            picture.add_run().add_picture(str(path), width=Inches(5.6))
+            label = document.add_paragraph(caption)
+            label.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
+        document.save(output_docx)
+
+        reopened = Document(output_docx)
+        if len(reopened.inline_shapes) != original_shapes + len(VENDOR_IMAGES):
+            raise ValueError("debug report did not embed exactly three vendor images")
+        text = _docx_text(output_docx)
+        required_text = {caption for _, caption, _ in VENDOR_IMAGES}
+        if not required_text.issubset(text):
+            raise ValueError("debug report is missing a vendor image caption")
+        forbidden = ("/home/", "\\\\wsl", "D:\\")
+        if any(value in text for value in forbidden):
+            raise ValueError("debug report leaked a local absolute path")
+        embedded = _embedded_media_hashes(output_docx)
+        staged_hashes = {_sha256(path) for path, _, _ in staged}
+        if not staged_hashes.issubset(embedded):
+            raise ValueError("vendor source bytes were not embedded unchanged")
+
+        receipt = {
+            "schema_version": "vendor_exact_debug_skinmaps_v1",
+            "status": "PASS",
+            "report_role": "engineering_debug",
+            "formal_reports_modified": False,
+            "source_debug_sha256": _sha256(source_debug),
+            "output_docx": {
+                "relative_path": output_docx.relative_to(output_root).as_posix(),
+                "sha256": _sha256(output_docx),
+                "size_bytes": output_docx.stat().st_size,
+            },
+            "vendor_images": [
+                {
+                    "relative_path": path.relative_to(output_root).as_posix(),
+                    "sha256": _sha256(path),
+                    "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
+                }
+                for path, _, _ in staged
+            ],
+            "checks": {
+                "three_vendor_images_embedded": True,
+                "embedded_bytes_match_sources": True,
+                "absolute_paths_absent": True,
+                "dermavision_measurement_inputs_used": False,
+                "debug_only": True,
+            },
+        }
+        receipt_path = output_root / "validation_receipt.json"
+        receipt_path.write_text(
+            json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
+            encoding="utf-8",
+        )
+        return output_docx, receipt_path
+    except BaseException:
+        shutil.rmtree(output_root, ignore_errors=True)
+        raise
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--source-debug", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--vendor-root", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output_docx, receipt = build_debug_report(
+        args.source_debug,
+        args.vendor_root,
+        args.output,
+    )
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "output_docx": str(output_docx),
+        "output_sha256": _sha256(output_docx),
+        "receipt": str(receipt),
+    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

class CArchiveReader:
    """
    Reader for PyInstaller's CArchive (PKG) archive.
    """

    # Cookie - holds some information for the bootloader. C struct format definition. '!' at the beginning means network
    # byte order. C struct looks like:
    #
    # typedef struct _archive_cookie
    # {
    #     char magic[8];
    #     uint32_t pkg_length;
    #     uint32_t toc_offset;
    #     uint32_t toc_length;
    #     uint32_t python_version;
    #     char python_libname[64];
    # } ARCHIVE_COOKIE;
    #
    _COOKIE_MAGIC_PATTERN = b'MEI\014\013\012\013\016'

    _COOKIE_FORMAT = '!8sIIII64s'
    _COOKIE_LENGTH = struct.calcsize(_COOKIE_FORMAT)

    # TOC entry:
    #
    # typedef struct _toc_entry
    # {
    #     uint32_t entry_length;
    #     uint32_t offset;
    #     uint32_t length;
    #     uint32_t uncompressed_length;
    #     unsigned char compression_flag;
    #     char typecode;
    #     char name[1]; /* Variable-length name, padded to multiple of 16 */
    # } TOC_ENTRY;
    #
    _TOC_ENTRY_FORMAT = '!IIIIBc'
    _TOC_ENTRY_LENGTH = struct.calcsize(_TOC_ENTRY_FORMAT)

    def __init__(self, filename):
        self._filename = filename
        self._start_offset = 0
        self._end_offset = 0
        self._toc_offset = 0
        self._toc_length = 0

        self.toc = {}
        self.options = []

        # Load TOC
        with open(self._filename, "rb") as fp:
            # Find cookie MAGIC pattern
            cookie_start_offset = self._find_magic_pattern(fp, self._COOKIE_MAGIC_PATTERN)
            if cookie_start_offset == -1:
                raise ArchiveReadError("Could not find COOKIE magic pattern!")

            # Read the whole cookie
            fp.seek(cookie_start_offset, os.SEEK_SET)
            cookie_data = fp.read(self._COOKIE_LENGTH)

            magic, archive_length, toc_offset, toc_length, pyvers, pylib_name = \
                struct.unpack(self._COOKIE_FORMAT, cookie_data)

            # Compute start and end offset of the the archive
            self._end_offset = cookie_start_offset + self._COOKIE_LENGTH
            self._start_offset = self._end_offset - archive_length

            # Verify that Python shared library name is set
            if not pylib_name:
                raise ArchiveReadError("Python shared library name not set in the archive!")

            # Read whole toc
            fp.seek(self._start_offset + toc_offset)
            toc_data = fp.read(toc_length)

            self.toc, self.options = self._parse_toc(toc_data)

    @staticmethod
    def _find_magic_pattern(fp, magic_pattern):
        # Start at the end of file, and scan back-to-start
        fp.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
        end_pos = fp.tell()

        # Scan from back
        SEARCH_CHUNK_SIZE = 8192
        magic_offset = -1
        while end_pos >= len(magic_pattern):
            start_pos = max(end_pos - SEARCH_CHUNK_SIZE, 0)
            chunk_size = end_pos - start_pos
            # Is the remaining chunk large enough to hold the pattern?
            if chunk_size < len(magic_pattern):
                break
            # Read and scan the chunk
            fp.seek(start_pos, os.SEEK_SET)
            buf = fp.read(chunk_size)
            pos = buf.rfind(magic_pattern)
            if pos != -1:
                magic_offset = start_pos + pos
                break
            # Adjust search location for next chunk; ensure proper overlap
            end_pos = start_pos + len(magic_pattern) - 1

        return magic_offset

    @classmethod
    def _parse_toc(cls, data):
        options = []
        toc = {}
        cur_pos = 0
        while cur_pos < len(data):
            # Read and parse the fixed-size TOC entry header
            entry_length, entry_offset, data_length, uncompressed_length, compression_flag, typecode = \
                struct.unpack(cls._TOC_ENTRY_FORMAT, data[cur_pos:(cur_pos + cls._TOC_ENTRY_LENGTH)])
            cur_pos += cls._TOC_ENTRY_LENGTH
            # Read variable-length name
            name_length = entry_length - cls._TOC_ENTRY_LENGTH
            name, *_ = struct.unpack(f'{name_length}s', data[cur_pos:(cur_pos + name_length)])
            cur_pos += name_length
            # Name string may contain up to 15 bytes of padding
            name = name.rstrip(b'\0').decode('utf-8')

            typecode = typecode.decode('ascii')

            # The TOC should not contain duplicates, except for OPTION entries. Therefore, keep those
            # in a separate list. With options, the rest of the entries do not make sense, anyway.
            if typecode == 'o':
                options.append(name)
            else:
                toc[name] = (entry_offset, data_length, uncompressed_length, compression_flag, typecode)

        return toc, options

    def extract(self, name):
        """
        Extract data for the given entry name.
        """

        entry = self.toc.get(name)
        if entry is None:
            raise KeyError(f"No entry named {name!r} found in the archive!")

        entry_offset, data_length, uncompressed_length, compression_flag, typecode = entry
        with open(self._filename, "rb") as fp:
            fp.seek(self._start_offset + entry_offset, os.SEEK_SET)
            data = fp.read(data_length)

        if compression_flag:
            import zlib
            data = zlib.decompress(data)

        return data

    def raw_pkg_data(self):
        """
        Extract complete PKG/CArchive archive from the parent file (executable).
        """
        total_length = self._end_offset - self._start_offset
        with open(self._filename, "rb") as fp:
            fp.seek(self._start_offset, os.SEEK_SET)
            return fp.read(total_length)

    def open_embedded_archive(self, name):
        """
        Open new archive reader for the embedded archive.
        """

        entry = self.toc.get(name)
        if entry is None:
            raise KeyError(f"No entry named {name!r} found in the archive!")

        entry_offset, data_length, uncompressed_length, compression_flag, typecode = entry

        if typecode == PKG_ITEM_PYZ:
            # Open as embedded archive, without extraction.
            return ZlibArchiveReader(self._filename, self._start_offset + entry_offset)
        elif typecode == PKG_ITEM_ZIPFILE:
            raise NotAnArchiveError("Zipfile archives not supported yet!")
        else:
            raise NotAnArchiveError(f"Entry {name!r} is not a supported embedded archive!")


def pkg_archive_contents(filename, recursive=True):
    """
    List the contents of the PKG / CArchive. If `recursive` flag is set (the default), the contents of the embedded PYZ
    archive is included as well.

    Used by the tests.
    """

    contents = []

    pkg_archive = CArchiveReader(filename)
    for name, toc_entry in pkg_archive.toc.items():
        *_, typecode = toc_entry
        contents.append(name)
        if typecode == PKG_ITEM_PYZ and recursive:
            pyz_archive = pkg_archive.open_embedded_archive(name)
            for name in pyz_archive.toc.keys():
                contents.append(name)

    return contents

class ZlibArchiveReader:
    """
    Reader for PyInstaller's PYZ (ZlibArchive) archive. The archive is used to store collected byte-compiled Python
    modules, as individually-compressed entries.
    """
    _PYZ_MAGIC_PATTERN = b'PYZ\0'

    def __init__(self, filename, start_offset=None, check_pymagic=False):
        self._filename = filename
        self._start_offset = start_offset

        self.toc = {}

        # If no offset is given, try inferring it from filename
        if start_offset is None:
            self._filename, self._start_offset = self._parse_offset_from_filename(filename)

        # Parse header and load TOC. Standard header contains 12 bytes: PYZ magic pattern, python bytecode magic
        # pattern, and offset to TOC (32-bit integer). It might be followed by additional fields, depending on
        # implementation version.
        with open(self._filename, "rb") as fp:
            # Read PYZ magic pattern, located at the start of the file
            fp.seek(self._start_offset, os.SEEK_SET)

            magic = fp.read(len(self._PYZ_MAGIC_PATTERN))
            if magic != self._PYZ_MAGIC_PATTERN:
                raise ArchiveReadError("PYZ magic pattern mismatch!")

            # Read python magic/version number
            pymagic = fp.read(len(PYTHON_MAGIC_NUMBER))
            if check_pymagic and pymagic != PYTHON_MAGIC_NUMBER:
                raise ArchiveReadError("Python magic pattern mismatch!")

            # Read TOC offset
            toc_offset, *_ = struct.unpack('!i', fp.read(4))

            # Load TOC
            fp.seek(self._start_offset + toc_offset, os.SEEK_SET)
            self.toc = dict(marshal.load(fp))

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_offset_from_filename(filename):
        """
        Parse the numeric offset from filename, stored as: `/path/to/file?offset`.
        """
        offset = 0

        idx = filename.rfind('?')
        if idx == -1:
            return filename, offset

        try:
            offset = int(filename[idx + 1:])
            filename = filename[:idx]  # Remove the offset from filename
        except ValueError:
            # Ignore spurious "?" in the path (for example, like in Windows UNC \\?\<path>).
            pass

        return filename, offset

    def extract(self, name, raw=False):
        """
        Extract data from entry with the given name.

        If the entry belongs to a module or a package, the data is loaded (unmarshaled) into code object. To retrieve
        raw data, set `raw` flag to True.
        """
        # Look up entry
        entry = self.toc.get(name)
        if entry is None:
            raise KeyError(f"No entry named {name!r} found in the archive!")

        typecode, entry_offset, entry_length = entry

        # PEP-420 namespace package does not have a data blob.
        if typecode == PYZ_ITEM_NSPKG:
            return None

        # Read data blob
        try:
            with open(self._filename, "rb") as fp:
                fp.seek(self._start_offset + entry_offset)
                obj = fp.read(entry_length)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            # We open the archive file each time we need to read from it, to avoid locking the file by keeping it open.
            # This allows executable to be deleted or moved (renamed) while it is running, which is useful in certain
            # scenarios (e.g., automatic update that replaces the executable). The caveat is that once the executable is
            # renamed, we cannot read from its embedded PYZ archive anymore. In such case, exit with informative
            # message.
            raise SystemExit(
                f"ERROR: {self._filename} appears to have been moved or deleted since this application was launched. "
                "Continouation from this state is impossible. Exiting now."
            )

        try:
            obj = zlib.decompress(obj)
            if typecode in (PYZ_ITEM_MODULE, PYZ_ITEM_PKG) and not raw:
                obj = marshal.loads(obj)
        except EOFError as e:
            raise ImportError(f"Failed to unmarshal PYZ entry {name!r}!") from e

        return obj

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Extract selected vendor PyInstaller modules as sourceless Python bytecode.

This helper does not decompile or modify the vendor implementation. It copies
the original code objects out of the executable's embedded PYZ archive so the
vendor's matching Python runtime can execute the original implementation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import importlib._bootstrap_external
from pathlib import Path

from PyInstaller.archive.readers import CArchiveReader


def _module_path(root: Path, name: str, *, is_package: bool) -> Path:
    parts = name.split(".")
    if is_package:
        return root.joinpath(*parts, "__init__.pyc")
    return root.joinpath(*parts[:-1], f"{parts[-1]}.pyc")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--executable", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--prefix", default="core")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    archive = CArchiveReader(str(args.executable))
    pyz_name = next(name for name, entry in archive.toc.items() if entry[-1] == "z")
    pyz = archive.open_embedded_archive(pyz_name)

    selected = sorted(
        name
        for name in pyz.toc
        if name == args.prefix or name.startswith(f"{args.prefix}.")
    )
    if not selected:
        raise RuntimeError(f"No modules found for prefix {args.prefix!r}")

    for name in selected:
        typecode = pyz.toc[name][0]
        code = pyz.extract(name)
        if code is None:
            continue
        target = _module_path(args.output, name, is_package=typecode == 1)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        pyc = importlib._bootstrap_external._code_to_timestamp_pyc(
            code,
            mtime=0,
            source_size=0,
        )
        target.write_bytes(pyc)

    print(f"extracted_modules={len(selected)}")
    print(f"output={args.output}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

"""Append archived Vendor Exact skin maps to an engineering-debug DOCX only."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from docx import Document
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.shared import Inches


VENDOR_IMAGES = (
    (
        "BROWN_M.jpg",
        "厂家原生 Brown 综合色素图",
        "综合色素增强显示；由厂家 /generate 直接输出。",
    ),
    (
        "RED_M.jpg",
        "厂家原生 Red 红区图",
        "红区增强显示；由厂家 /generate 直接输出。",
    ),
    (
        "REDNE_M.jpg",
        "厂家原生 RedNE 红褐联合图",
        "红褐联合增强显示；由厂家 /generate 直接输出。",
    ),
)


def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _bounded_image(root: Path, filename: str) -> Path:
    source_root = root.resolve(strict=True)
    path = (source_root / filename).resolve(strict=True)
    if not path.is_relative_to(source_root) or path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError(f"vendor image escaped the fixed root: {filename}")
    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(path)
    return path


def _docx_text(path: Path) -> str:
    document = Document(path)
    return "\n".join(paragraph.text for paragraph in document.paragraphs) + "\n" + "\n".join(
        cell.text
        for table in document.tables
        for row in table.rows
        for cell in row.cells
    )


def _embedded_media_hashes(path: Path) -> set[str]:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        return {
            hashlib.sha256(archive.read(name)).hexdigest()
            for name in archive.namelist()
            if name.startswith("word/media/")
        }


def build_debug_report(
    source_debug: Path,
    vendor_root: Path,
    output_root: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    source_debug = source_debug.resolve(strict=True)
    if source_debug.suffix.lower() != ".docx":
        raise ValueError("source debug report must be a DOCX")
    if output_root.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(output_root)
    output_root.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)

    staged_root = output_root / "vendor_exact_raw"
    staged_root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    staged: list[tuple[Path, str, str]] = []
    try:
        for filename, caption, explanation in VENDOR_IMAGES:
            source = _bounded_image(vendor_root, filename)
            target = staged_root / filename
            shutil.copyfile(source, target)
            if _sha256(source) != _sha256(target):
                raise RuntimeError(f"vendor image copy hash mismatch: {filename}")
            staged.append((target, caption, explanation))

        output_docx = output_root / "AISIA_clinic28-25_工程调试报告_厂家原生红棕对照.docx"
        document = Document(source_debug)
        original_shapes = len(document.inline_shapes)
        document.add_page_break()
        document.add_heading("厂家原生红棕增强图（调试对照）", level=1)
        document.add_paragraph(
            "以下图像为同一仪器采集会话中已保存的厂家 /generate 原生成品。"
            "厂家输入为 RGB、CP、365 三种通道的 L/M/R 九张图；PP 不参与该接口。"
        )
        document.add_paragraph(
            "本节未运行 DermaVision 检测器，未使用我们的 Mask、score map、ROI 或调色器。"
            "仅用于调试视觉对照，不进入用户正式版或医生正式版。"
        )
        document.add_paragraph(
            "finding_backend=vendor_multispectral_exact_archived；license_status=unknown。"
        )
        for path, caption, explanation in staged:
            document.add_heading(caption, level=2)
            document.add_paragraph(explanation)
            picture = document.add_paragraph()
            picture.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
            picture.add_run().add_picture(str(path), width=Inches(5.6))
            label = document.add_paragraph(caption)
            label.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        document.save(output_docx)

        reopened = Document(output_docx)
        if len(reopened.inline_shapes) != original_shapes + len(VENDOR_IMAGES):
            raise ValueError("debug report did not embed exactly three vendor images")
        text = _docx_text(output_docx)
        required_text = {caption for _, caption, _ in VENDOR_IMAGES}
        if not all(caption in text for caption in required_text):
            raise ValueError("debug report is missing a vendor image caption")
        forbidden = ("/home/", "\\\\wsl", "D:\\")
        if any(value in text for value in forbidden):
            raise ValueError("debug report leaked a local absolute path")
        embedded = _embedded_media_hashes(output_docx)
        staged_hashes = {_sha256(path) for path, _, _ in staged}
        if not staged_hashes.issubset(embedded):
            raise ValueError("vendor source bytes were not embedded unchanged")

        receipt = {
            "schema_version": "vendor_exact_debug_skinmaps_v1",
            "status": "PASS",
            "report_role": "engineering_debug",
            "formal_reports_modified": False,
            "source_debug_sha256": _sha256(source_debug),
            "output_docx": {
                "relative_path": output_docx.relative_to(output_root).as_posix(),
                "sha256": _sha256(output_docx),
                "size_bytes": output_docx.stat().st_size,
            },
            "vendor_images": [
                {
                    "relative_path": path.relative_to(output_root).as_posix(),
                    "sha256": _sha256(path),
                    "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                }
                for path, _, _ in staged
            ],
            "checks": {
                "three_vendor_images_embedded": True,
                "embedded_bytes_match_sources": True,
                "absolute_paths_absent": True,
                "dermavision_measurement_inputs_used": False,
                "debug_only": True,
            },
        }
        receipt_path = output_root / "validation_receipt.json"
        receipt_path.write_text(
            json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        return output_docx, receipt_path
    except BaseException:
        shutil.rmtree(output_root, ignore_errors=True)
        raise


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--source-debug", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--vendor-root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output_docx, receipt = build_debug_report(
        args.source_debug,
        args.vendor_root,
        args.output,
    )

厂家不是用一个统一模型完成全部检测，而是组合下列组件。下表把“本地文件或运行行为
可以直接确认”和“根据输出/命名推断但公式仍封装”严格分开：

|---|---|---|---|
| **确认** | MediaPipe Face Detection/Landmark | Engine包含人脸检测和关键点模型，厂家检测入口使用人脸与关键点结果 | `Engine/_internal/models/face_detection_*.tflite`、`face_landmark*.tflite`；具体业务分区规则仍有封装部分 |
| **确认** | DeepLabV3+ | Engine包含DeepLabV3+实现和对应脸轮廓、红斑、红血丝、综合色素、黄褐斑分割权重 | `face_contour.pth`、`erythema30.pth`、`couperose10.pth`、`Pigmentation21.pth`、`chloasma8.pth`及`nets/deeplabv3_plus.py` |
| **确认** | Ultralytics检测/分割 | Engine包含Ultralytics运行库及痤疮、斑类、褐青色痣、皱纹相关检测/分割权重 | `acne.pt`、`pimple.pt`、`qsban.pt`、`ADM.pt`、`wrinkle.pt`；部分子项与后处理的精确绑定仍在业务核心中 |

| **确认** | OpenCV/图像处理运行能力 | Engine包含OpenCV，实际输出含轮廓、点、计数、面积、位置和对称性字段 | `opencv_world3410.dll`、厂家JSON和增强图；不能仅凭这些证据恢复每条规则的公式 |

- `*_preview.jpg` 是 `SkinMapLocal` 新增的展示层：把厂家标注按原坐标叠加到对应
  `RGB_L/M/R.jpg`。最长边1600、JPEG质量95、宽高比和检测位置不变。
- `RESULT_INDEX.html` 是本项目新增的离线中文索引；它不改变厂家检测值。
- `RED/BROWN/REDNE` 是厂家 `/generate` 直接输出。
- `erythema_overlay.png`、`pigmentation_overlay.png` 等派生图是本项目根据厂家区域生成
  的辅助展示，不应冒充厂家原图。

正式追溯使用 `vendor_response.json` 和 raw layer；面向用户默认打开
`RESULT_INDEX.html` 或 `*_preview.jpg`。

结论如下：

1. 这次实际生成 RED/BROWN/REDNE 的输入，是交叉偏振光 `CP_M/CP_L/CP_R` 三张图。

虽然旧的 `/generate` 外层接口还列出了 RGB、CP、365 共9张图，但当前 `XingerEngine.exe` 内真正执行的 `core.skin_generate.Enhence_images` 只接收：

```text
CP_M + CP_L + CP_R + 输出目录 + 生成类型
```

RGB和365没有参与这次红棕图生成。完整厂家25项 `/detect` 才需要 RGB/CP/365 的 L/M/R 九张图。

2. `REDNE` 是厂家内部称为 `hxs` 的“红血丝/红色线状结构增强图”。

它的生成过程是：

```text
CP图
  → RED红区算法生成灰度Mask
  → CP图 + RED灰度Mask
  → deal_hxs
  → REDNE
```

它主要是独立的红色血管样/红血丝增强显示图，不是厂家25项检测的必需中间输入。厂家 `/detect` 直接读取原始多光谱照片，不会读取 RED/BROWN/REDNE；这些图更接近辅助观察和展示产物。厂家没有给出“REDNE”缩写的官方展开，因此不建议我们自行解释英文全称。

3. 如果要保持“厂家原版效果”，目前不能只输入正面图。

原因是厂家算法并非将三张图完全独立计算：

- RED会分别分析M/L/R，然后把三张图的阈值和模糊度取平均，再生成正面结果。
- BROWN也会综合三张图计算共享的颜色距离参数。
- REDNE正面结果使用正面CP图，但依赖RED阶段产生的Mask，而RED参数已经受到L/R影响。

所以即使报告只显示 `RED_M/BROWN_M/REDNE_M`，后台仍应输入 `CP_L/CP_M/CP_R`，侧面结果可以不进入报告。

不建议把正面图复制三份冒充L/M/R，这样虽然能运行，但结果不再是经过验证的厂家原版效果。

最合适的现阶段方案是：

- 正式报告：继续使用我们自己的四张正面图算法。
- 厂家红棕调试：后台读取CP三视角，只在调试报告展示M正面结果。
- 如果以后仪器只保留正面图，再单独开发“M-only厂家风格适配版”，但必须标记为我们的适配算法，不能称为厂家Exact等价结果。

实际变化：

- WSL文件缓存：约7.9GiB → 2.0GiB
- WSL空闲内存：约30GiB → 36GiB
- 待写回脏页：约1.36GiB → 3.7MiB

为什么每次运行都会突然满载：

1. 厂家原图是 `5472×3648`，三张CP图解码后约占180MiB；厂家代码还会深拷贝、缩放并同时生成RED/BROWN/REDNE，单次峰值会达到数百MiB。
2. 生成9张高分辨率JPEG时，厂家代码内部三个任务并发写入。
3. 调试Word包含大量图片，每次重新保存都要读取、解压并重新打包整个DOCX。
4. Linux会把读过的图片、DOCX和程序保留为文件缓存。进程虽然结束了，但Windows任务管理器暂时仍把这些页面算在WSL内存里。
5. WSL虚拟磁盘在D盘机械硬盘上。大量小文件遍历、DOCX压缩以及多张图片写入，会造成“吞吐量不算特别高，但活动时间100%、响应时间几十毫秒”的机械盘饱和状态。
6. 本轮发现的1.36GiB脏页远大于刚生成的约89MiB项目产物，因此不能说全部写入都来自这三张红棕图；我没有继续枚举或处理其他进程。

你的 `.wslconfig` 中 `autoMemoryReclaim=dropCache` 方向是正确的，微软说明该设置会主动回收WSL文件缓存。[微软WSL高级配置说明](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/wsl/wsl-config)

后续我会固定采用这些限制：

- 不再递归扫描整个`test-output`、旧工作树或`.venv`。
- 只读取manifest明确列出的图片和产物。
- 图片任务单套串行，不同时生成多套报告。
- 同一份Word只做一次最终打包，避免反复生成中间版本。
- 重任务结束后检查`Cached/Dirty`；缓存明显偏高时只释放干净缓存，不强制同步制造新的D盘满载。
- 只管理本项目任务，不枚举或终止其他WSL进程。

现在剩余约9.1GiB属于WSL内核和仍在运行的程序实际内存，不能在不终止进程的情况下全部清零。若要让WSL占用彻底归零，唯一办法是Windows执行`wsl --shutdown`，但那会同时终止当前Codex和所有发行版，所以我没有执行。

from __future__ import annotations

"""Append archived Vendor Exact skin maps to an engineering-debug DOCX only."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import shutil
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from docx import Document
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.shared import Inches


VENDOR_IMAGES = (
    (
        "BROWN_M.jpg",
        "厂家原生 Brown 综合色素图",
        "综合色素增强显示；由厂家 /generate 直接输出。",
    ),
    (
        "RED_M.jpg",
        "厂家原生 Red 红区图",
        "红区增强显示；由厂家 /generate 直接输出。",
    ),

        "REDNE_M.jpg",
        "厂家原生 RedNE 红褐联合图",
        "红褐联合增强显示；由厂家 /generate 直接输出。",
    ),
)


def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _bounded_image(root: Path, filename: str) -> Path:
    source_root = root.resolve(strict=True)
    path = (source_root / filename).resolve(strict=True)
    if not path.is_relative_to(source_root) or path.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError(f"vendor image escaped the fixed root: {filename}")
    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(path)
    return path


def _docx_text(path: Path) -> str:
    document = Document(path)
    return "\n".join(paragraph.text for paragraph in document.paragraphs) + "\n" + "\n".join(
        cell.text
        for table in document.tables
        for row in table.rows
        for cell in row.cells
    )


def _embedded_media_hashes(path: Path) -> set[str]:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        return {
            hashlib.sha256(archive.read(name)).hexdigest()
            for name in archive.namelist()
            if name.startswith("word/media/")
        }


def build_debug_report(
    source_debug: Path,
    vendor_root: Path,
    output_root: Path,
) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    source_debug = source_debug.resolve(strict=True)
    if source_debug.suffix.lower() != ".docx":
        raise ValueError("source debug report must be a DOCX")
    if output_root.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(output_root)
    output_root.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)

    staged_root = output_root / "vendor_exact_raw"
    staged_root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    staged: list[tuple[Path, str, str]] = []
    try:
        for filename, caption, explanation in VENDOR_IMAGES:
            source = _bounded_image(vendor_root, filename)
            target = staged_root / filename
            shutil.copyfile(source, target)
            if _sha256(source) != _sha256(target):
                raise RuntimeError(f"vendor image copy hash mismatch: {filename}")
            staged.append((target, caption, explanation))

        output_docx = output_root / "AISIA_clinic28-25_工程调试报告_厂家原生红棕对照.docx"
        document = Document(source_debug)
        original_shapes = len(document.inline_shapes)
        document.add_page_break()
        document.add_heading("厂家原生红棕增强图（调试对照）", level=1)
        document.add_paragraph(
            "以下图像为同一仪器采集会话中已保存的厂家 /generate 原生成品。"
            "厂家输入为 RGB、CP、365 三种通道的 L/M/R 九张图；PP 不参与该接口。"
        )
        document.add_paragraph(
            "本节未运行 DermaVision 检测器，未使用我们的 Mask、score map、ROI 或调色器。"
            "仅用于调试视觉对照，不进入用户正式版或医生正式版。"
        )
        document.add_paragraph(
            "finding_backend=vendor_multispectral_exact_archived；license_status=unknown。"
        )
        for path, caption, explanation in staged:
            document.add_heading(caption, level=2)
            document.add_paragraph(explanation)
            picture = document.add_paragraph()
            picture.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
            picture.add_run().add_picture(str(path), width=Inches(5.6))
            label = document.add_paragraph(caption)
            label.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        document.save(output_docx)

        reopened = Document(output_docx)
        if len(reopened.inline_shapes) != original_shapes + len(VENDOR_IMAGES):
            raise ValueError("debug report did not embed exactly three vendor images")
        text = _docx_text(output_docx)
        required_text = {caption for _, caption, _ in VENDOR_IMAGES}
        if not all(caption in text for caption in required_text):
            raise ValueError("debug report is missing a vendor image caption")
        forbidden = ("/home/", "\\\\wsl", "D:\\")
        if any(value in text for value in forbidden):
            raise ValueError("debug report leaked a local absolute path")
        embedded = _embedded_media_hashes(output_docx)
        staged_hashes = {_sha256(path) for path, _, _ in staged}
        if not staged_hashes.issubset(embedded):
            raise ValueError("vendor source bytes were not embedded unchanged")

        receipt = {
            "schema_version": "vendor_exact_debug_skinmaps_v1",
            "status": "PASS",
            "report_role": "engineering_debug",
            "formal_reports_modified": False,
            "source_debug_sha256": _sha256(source_debug),
            "output_docx": {
                "relative_path": output_docx.relative_to(output_root).as_posix(),
                "sha256": _sha256(output_docx),
                "size_bytes": output_docx.stat().st_size,
            },
            "vendor_images": [
                {
                    "relative_path": path.relative_to(output_root).as_posix(),
                    "sha256": _sha256(path),
                    "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
                }
                for path, _, _ in staged
            ],
            "checks": {
                "three_vendor_images_embedded": True,
                "embedded_bytes_match_sources": True,
                "absolute_paths_absent": True,
                "dermavision_measurement_inputs_used": False,
                "debug_only": True,
            },
        }
        receipt_path = output_root / "validation_receipt.json"
        receipt_path.write_text(
            json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        return output_docx, receipt_path
    except BaseException:
        shutil.rmtree(output_root, ignore_errors=True)
        raise


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--source-debug", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--vendor-root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output_docx, receipt = build_debug_report(
        args.source_debug,
        args.vendor_root,
        args.output,
    )
    print(json.dumps({
        "output_docx": str(output_docx),
        "output_sha256": _sha256(output_docx),
        "receipt": str(receipt),
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":

    count, labels, _, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(non_white, 8)

    return foreground if np.any(foreground) else face_mask.copy()

def _fill_landmark_feature(
    mask: np.ndarray,
    points: np.ndarray,
    indices: list[int],
    dilate: int,
) -> None:
    valid = [index for index in indices if index < len(points)]
    if len(valid) < 3:
        return
    local = np.zeros_like(mask)
    polygon = cv2.convexHull(np.rint(points[valid]).astype(np.int32))
    cv2.fillConvexPoly(local, polygon, 255)
    if dilate > 1:
        local = cv2.dilate(
            local,
            cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (dilate, dilate)),
        )
    mask[:] = cv2.bitwise_or(mask, local)


def build_nostril_exclusion_mask(
    analysis_image: np.ndarray,
    points: np.ndarray,
    use_photometric_refinement: bool = True,
) -> np.ndarray:
    """Build a scale-aware nostril aperture mask from geometry and dark pixels.

    Landmarks 98 and 327 sit near the outer nose base, so each seed is moved
    toward landmark 2 before looking for the local dark connected component.
    The search is deliberately restricted to two small lower-nose ROIs; this
    avoids removing genuine findings on the nose wings.
    """
    shape = analysis_image.shape[:2]
    mask = np.zeros(shape, dtype=np.uint8)
    if len(points) <= 327:
        return mask

    left_outer = points[98].astype(np.float32)
    right_outer = points[327].astype(np.float32)
    nose_base = points[2].astype(np.float32)
    span = max(float(np.linalg.norm(right_outer - left_outer)), 1.0)
    radius_x = int(
        np.clip(
            round(0.18 * span),
            Config.NOSTRIL_MIN_RADIUS_X,
            Config.NOSTRIL_MAX_RADIUS_X,
        )
    )
    radius_y = int(
        np.clip(
            round(0.11 * span),
            Config.NOSTRIL_MIN_RADIUS_Y,
            Config.NOSTRIL_MAX_RADIUS_Y,
        )
    )
    centres = (
        0.68 * left_outer + 0.32 * nose_base,
        0.68 * right_outer + 0.32 * nose_base,
    )

    lab_l = (
        cv2.cvtColor(analysis_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB)[:, :, 0]
        if use_photometric_refinement
        else None
    )
    height, width = shape
    for centre_f in centres:
        centre = np.rint(centre_f).astype(np.int32)
        cx = int(np.clip(centre[0], 0, width - 1))
        cy = int(np.clip(centre[1], 0, height - 1))

        geometry = np.zeros(shape, dtype=np.uint8)
        cv2.ellipse(geometry, (cx, cy), (radius_x, radius_y), 0, 0, 360, 255, -1)
        mask = cv2.bitwise_or(mask, geometry)

        if not use_photometric_refinement:
            continue

        x0 = max(0, cx - 2 * radius_x)
        x1 = min(width, cx + 2 * radius_x + 1)
        y0 = max(0, cy - 2 * radius_y)
        y1 = min(height, cy + 2 * radius_y + 1)
        roi = lab_l[y0:y1, x0:x1]
        if roi.size < 25:
            continue
        median = float(np.median(roi))
        mad = float(np.median(np.abs(roi.astype(np.float32) - median)))
        threshold = median - max(6.0, 1.8 * 1.4826 * mad)
        dark = (roi.astype(np.float32) < threshold).astype(np.uint8)
        dark = cv2.morphologyEx(
            dark,
            cv2.MORPH_CLOSE,
            cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (3, 3)),
        )

        seed = np.zeros_like(dark)
        local_centre = (cx - x0, cy - y0)
        cv2.ellipse(
            seed,
            local_centre,
            (max(3, radius_x // 2), max(2, radius_y // 2)),
            0,
            0,
            360,
            1,
            -1,
        )
        count, labels, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(dark, connectivity=8)
        for label in range(1, count):
            component = labels == label
            area = int(stats[label, cv2.CC_STAT_AREA])
            if area <= 3 or area > int(roi.size * 0.55):
                continue
            if np.any(component & (seed > 0)):
                local_mask = mask[y0:y1, x0:x1]
                local_mask[component] = 255

    return cv2.dilate(
        mask,
        cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (5, 5)),
    )

    def _status_from_score(score: float, flags: list[str]) -> tuple[float, str]:
        hard_failures = {

            "MULTIPLE_FACES",
            "INVALID_IMAGE",
            "INVALID_FACE_GEOMETRY",
        }
        if hard_failures.intersection(flags):
            return min(float(score), Config.WARNING_SCORE - 1.0), "REJECT"
        severe_capture_failures = {"BLUR", "UNDEREXPOSED", "OVEREXPOSED"}
        if (
            "PARTIAL_FACE" in flags
            and score >= 45.0
            and not severe_capture_failures.intersection(flags)

        if score >= Config.PASS_SCORE:

        if score >= Config.WARNING_SCORE:

        points: np.ndarray,
        image_shape: tuple[int, int],
        original_person_mask: np.ndarray | None = None,
    ) -> np.ndarray | None:
        """Return an original-orientation square-crop transform.

        Despite the legacy method name, this intentionally does not rotate the
        face or force both eyes onto template coordinates.  It follows the older
        validated preprocessor idea: compute the visible face extent, crop that
        region from the original image, place it on a square canvas, and resize
        to the analysis size.  Display and analysis images therefore remain
        natural and complete, while skin_mask carries algorithm exclusions.
        """
        height, width = image_shape
        if points.size == 0 or height <= 0 or width <= 0:
            return None

        base_face_mask = self._face_hull_mask((height, width), points)
        geometry_mask, forehead_completion = self._forehead_geometry(
            (height, width),
            points,
            base_face_mask,
        )
        if original_person_mask is None:
            original_person_mask = np.full((height, width), 255, dtype=np.uint8)
        semantic_face = cv2.bitwise_or(
            (original_person_mask > 0).astype(np.uint8) * 255,
            forehead_completion,
        )
        crop_basis = cv2.bitwise_and(semantic_face, geometry_mask)
        if np.count_nonzero(crop_basis) < 20:
            crop_basis = geometry_mask

        y_coords, x_coords = np.where(crop_basis > 0)
        if y_coords.size == 0 or x_coords.size == 0:
            return None

        x_min = int(np.min(x_coords))
        x_max = int(np.max(x_coords))
        y_min = int(np.min(y_coords))
        y_max = int(np.max(y_coords))
        box_w = max(x_max - x_min + 1, 1)
        box_h = max(y_max - y_min + 1, 1)
        pad_x = int(round(box_w * Config.CROP_PAD_X_RATIO))
        pad_top = int(round(box_h * Config.CROP_PAD_TOP_RATIO))
        pad_bottom = int(round(box_h * Config.CROP_PAD_BOTTOM_RATIO))

        crop_x_min = max(0, x_min - pad_x)
        crop_x_max = min(width, x_max + pad_x + 1)
        crop_y_min = max(0, y_min - pad_top)
        crop_y_max = min(height, y_max + pad_bottom + 1)
        rect_w = max(crop_x_max - crop_x_min, 1)
        rect_h = max(crop_y_max - crop_y_min, 1)
        square_side = max(rect_w, rect_h)
        off_x = (square_side - rect_w) * 0.5
        off_y = (square_side - rect_h) * 0.5

                [0.0, scale, scale * (off_y - crop_y_min)],

def code_state() -> tuple[tuple[dict[str, object], ...], str]:
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for relative in FAST3_CODE_STATE_FILES:
        path = (PROJECT_ROOT / relative).resolve(strict=True)
        if not path.is_relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT) or path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError(f"invalid Fast3 code-state path: {relative}")
        rows.append(
            {
                "path": relative,

                "sha256": file_sha256(path),

    frozen = tuple(rows)

def _read_controlled_file(name: str) -> Path:
    candidate = STAGE3_ROOT / name
    path = candidate.resolve(strict=True)
    if path != candidate.absolute() or path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f"invalid Stage3 controlled file: {name}")

def _stage3_documents() -> tuple[dict, dict, bytes]:
    detailed_path = _read_controlled_file("detailed_manifest.json")
    receipt_path = _read_controlled_file("execution_receipt.json")
    key_path = _read_controlled_file("commitment.key")
    detailed = json.loads(detailed_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if file_sha256(detailed_path) != receipt["detailed_manifest_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("Stage3 detailed manifest differs from its execution receipt")
    if detailed.get("dataset_id") != "Clinic-Engineering28":
        raise ValueError("unexpected Stage3 dataset")
    key_bytes = key_path.read_bytes()
    try:
        key = bytes.fromhex(key_bytes.decode("ascii").strip())
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("Stage3 commitment key is not canonical hexadecimal") from exc
    if len(key) != 32:

    registration = row.get("registration")

def build_signed_fast3_manifest() -> SignedFast3Manifest:
    """Build the fixed Fast3 authority from the already controlled Stage3 facts."""

    detailed, receipt, key = _stage3_documents()
    capture_index = {item["capture_alias"]: item for item in detailed["captures"]}
    captures: list[Fast3ManifestCapture] = []
    for alias in CAPTURE_ORDER:
        source = capture_index.get(alias)
        if source is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Stage3 manifest is missing {alias}")
        if source["source_group_alias"] != EXPECTED_SOURCE_GROUPS[alias]:
            raise ValueError(f"source group drifted for {alias}")
        captures.append(
            Fast3ManifestCapture(
                capture_alias=alias,
                source_group_alias=source["source_group_alias"],
                source_capture_directory=source["source_capture_directory"],
                channels=tuple(_manifest_channel(row) for row in source["channels"]),
            )
        )
    _, state_hash = code_state()
    payload = Fast3ManifestPayload(
        stage3_detailed_manifest_sha256=receipt["detailed_manifest_sha256"],
        stage3_execution_receipt_sha256=file_sha256(
            _read_controlled_file("execution_receipt.json")
        ),
        source_archive_sha256=receipt["source_archive_sha256_after_extraction"],
        source_archive_size_bytes=detailed["source_archive_size_bytes"],
        code_state_sha256=state_hash,
        created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
        captures=tuple(captures),
    )
    signature = hmac.new(
        key,
        HMAC_DOMAIN + canonical_json_bytes(payload),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    return SignedFast3Manifest(
        key_id=receipt["commitment_key_id"],
        hmac_sha256=signature,
        payload=payload,
    )


def write_signed_fast3_manifest(path: Path = FAST3_MANIFEST_PATH) -> Path:
    manifest = build_signed_fast3_manifest()
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_name(f".{path.name}.{secrets.token_hex(6)}.tmp")
    temporary.write_bytes(canonical_json_bytes(manifest) + b"\n")
    os.replace(temporary, path)
    return path


def verify_signed_fast3_manifest(path: Path = FAST3_MANIFEST_PATH) -> SignedFast3Manifest:
    candidate = path.resolve(strict=True)
    if candidate != path.absolute() or path.is_symlink() or not candidate.is_file():

    _, receipt, key = _stage3_documents()
    if manifest.key_id != receipt["commitment_key_id"]:
        raise ValueError("Fast3 manifest key ID differs from Stage3 authority")
    expected = hmac.new(
        key,
        HMAC_DOMAIN + canonical_json_bytes(manifest.payload),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, manifest.hmac_sha256):
        raise ValueError("Fast3 manifest HMAC is invalid")
    _, current_code_hash = code_state()
    if manifest.payload.code_state_sha256 != current_code_hash:
        raise ValueError("Fast3 code state changed after manifest signing")
    return manifest

def _red_candidate(pre: PreprocessResultV2) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    lab_a = cv2.cvtColor(pre.analysis_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB)[:, :, 1].astype(np.float32)
    valid = _safe_feature_domain(pre, margin_px=13)
    values = lab_a[valid > 0]
    median = float(np.median(values)) if values.size else 128.0
    mad = float(np.median(np.abs(values - median))) if values.size else 1.0
    score = np.clip((lab_a - median) / max(3.0 * mad, 6.0), 0.0, 1.0).astype(np.float32)
    mask = ((score >= 0.52) & (valid > 0)).astype(np.uint8) * 255
    mask = cv2.morphologyEx(mask, cv2.MORPH_OPEN, np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8))
    return mask, score


def _diffuse_red_candidate(pre: PreprocessResultV2) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    valid = _safe_feature_domain(pre, margin_px=17)
    lab_a = cv2.cvtColor(pre.analysis_image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB)[:, :, 1].astype(np.float32)
    smooth = cv2.GaussianBlur(lab_a, (0, 0), 22.0)
    values = smooth[valid > 0]
    median = float(np.median(values)) if values.size else 128.0
    mad = float(np.median(np.abs(values - median))) if values.size else 1.0
    score = np.clip((smooth - median) / max(3.5 * mad, 5.0), 0.0, 1.0).astype(np.float32)
    mask = ((score >= 0.46) & (valid > 0)).astype(np.uint8) * 255
    mask = cv2.morphologyEx(
        mask,
        cv2.MORPH_OPEN,
        cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (9, 9)),
    )
    mask = cv2.morphologyEx(
        mask,
        cv2.MORPH_CLOSE,
        cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (15, 15)),
    )
    return mask, score

def prepare_capture(
    capture: Fast3ManifestCapture,
    extracted_root: Path,
    preprocessor: ImagePreprocessor,
) -> PreparedCapture:
    prepared: dict[str, PreprocessResultV2] = {}
    for channel in capture.channels:
        source = extracted_root / channel.source_member_path
        encoded = np.fromfile(source, dtype=np.uint8)
        image = cv2.imdecode(encoded, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        if image is None or image.shape[:2] != (channel.height, channel.width):
            raise ValueError(f"Fast3 decode or dimension mismatch: {capture.capture_alias}/{channel.role}")
        result = preprocessor.preprocess_image(image)
        if result.analysis_image.shape[:2] != (ANALYSIS_SIZE, ANALYSIS_SIZE):
            raise ValueError("preprocessor escaped the fixed 1024 analysis space")
        if result.landmarks.shape != (478, 2) or not np.all(np.isfinite(result.landmarks)):
            raise ValueError(f"Fast3 landmark gate failed: {capture.capture_alias}/{channel.role}")
        if int(np.count_nonzero(result.skin_mask)) < 500:
            raise ValueError(f"Fast3 valid-skin gate failed: {capture.capture_alias}/{channel.role}")
        prepared[channel.role] = result
    return PreparedCapture(capture, prepared)

    shape: tuple[int, int],
    landmarks: np.ndarray,
    indices: tuple[int, ...] | list[int],
) -> np.ndarray:
    mask = np.zeros(shape, dtype=np.uint8)

    if len(valid) < 3:

def _chaikin_open_curve(points: np.ndarray, iterations: int = 3) -> np.ndarray:
    """Smooth an open landmark path while preserving both endpoints."""
    curve = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1, 2)
    if len(curve) < 2:
        return curve
    for _ in range(max(0, int(iterations))):
        first = 0.75 * curve[:-1] + 0.25 * curve[1:]

        smoothed = np.empty((2 * len(first) + 2, 2), dtype=np.float32)
        smoothed[0] = curve[0]
        smoothed[-1] = curve[-1]
        smoothed[1:-1:2] = first
        smoothed[2:-1:2] = second
        curve = smoothed
    return curve

) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return anatomical nasolabial corridors and their center lines.

    whole corridor because real spots and pores may occur there.

    corridor = np.zeros(shape, dtype=np.uint8)

    points = np.asarray(landmarks, dtype=np.float32)
    for indices in NASOLABIAL_PATHS:

# SkinMapLocal

`SkinMapLocal` 是从 `FaceReconstructionLocal` 拆出的独立红区/棕区项目。它不包含
FLAME、Open3D、RGB-D、OBJ/GLB 或其他 3D 代码。

## 工程目标

- `skinmap_core`：公共 C++ 算法与厂家适配库。
- `skinmap_service.exe`：异步本地 HTTP 服务。
- `skin_map_rgb.exe`：单 RGB CLI。
- `skin_map_instrument.exe`：厂家多光谱 CLI。
- `skin_map_calibrate.exe`：RGB 风格标定工具。
- `skinmap_tests.exe`：独立测试及可选真人黄金回归。

当前提供纯 C++/OpenCV 的单张 RGB 视觉近似：

```powershell
cmake -S . -B build -A x64
cmake --build build --config Release --target skin_map_rgb
build\Release\skin_map_rgb.exe `
  --image "手机白光照片.jpg" `
  --device-profile generic `
  --output "result"
```

结果用于仪器风格展示，不等同于 CP/365 多光谱测量：

```json
{
  "measurement_grade": false,
  "diagnostic_grade": false
}
```

厂家多光谱 exact 路线要求 RGB、CP、365 三视角共 9 图；PP 三视角为可选
采集信息，不参与当前已确认的厂家 `/generate` 和 `/detect` 算法：

```powershell
build\Release\skin_map_instrument.exe `
  --input-dir "完整9图或12图目录" `
  --vendor-engine "..\Engine" `
  --output "instrument-result"
```

缺少任何 RGB、CP 或 365 图片会返回 `MISSING_MODALITY`。PP 可以提供 0–3 张；
只提供 1–2 张时任务继续执行并记录 `PARTIAL_PP_CAPTURE`。程序只会关闭由它自己
启动的 `XingerEngine.exe`，不会终止用户预先启动的厂家服务。

Exact 任务除 9 张 RED/BROWN/REDNE 外，还输出：

- `vendor_response.json`：厂家响应原样语义归档。
- `analysis.json`：`skin-analysis/1.0` 标准化的 25 项检测结果。
- 厂家 `output_imgs` 中所有安全的原始标注层，标记为 `raw_overlay`，不会被改写或
  冒充成品图。厂家当前样本同时存在RGBA透明层和三通道黑底稀疏层，两种编码都会
  原样保存并在artifact元数据中注明。
- 每个 L/M/R 标注层叠加到对应 `RGB_L/M/R.jpg` 后生成最长边 1600、JPEG 95
  的 `*_preview.jpg`；预览标记为默认用户视图，并与原始检测层（透明或三通道黑底
  标注层）显式配对。
- `RESULT_INDEX.html`：可离线打开的 25 项中英文结果索引；含等级、计数和预览，
  没有图像的检测项明确标记为 `JSON-only`。
- 可选红斑/色素派生掩码；对应增强图缺失时仅告警，不伪造图片。

厂家响应还必须满足业务层 `status == 200`，且 `data` 至少包含一个已知检测字段；
HTTP 200 但业务失败或空检测数据会被拒绝。厂家增强图发布前会实际解码校验，并受
32 MiB 单文件、256 MiB 单任务及 1 亿像素单图上限保护。

25 项检测包括肤质、痤疮、色素、红斑血管和眼周皱纹五组；其中 8 项为厂家
真实返回但当前前端隐藏的 `supported_hidden`。另有 6 项只存在配置或权重证据，
仅在能力清单中标记为 `experimental_unverified`。

异步 HTTP 服务默认只监听 `127.0.0.1:8765`：

```powershell
build\Release\skinmap_service.exe --root .
```

端点：

- `POST /v1/skin-maps/rgb`
- `POST /v1/skin-maps/instrument`
- `GET /v1/skin-maps/{job_id}`
- `GET /v1/skin-maps/{job_id}/result`
- `GET /v1/skin-maps/{job_id}/artifacts/{name}`
- `DELETE /v1/skin-maps/{job_id}`
- `GET /v1/skin-maps/capabilities`
- `GET /health`

单 RGB 结果固定记录 `vendor_equivalent:false` 和 `trend_eligible:false`，不会返回
厂家 25 项 exact 检测。

独立发布包已可通过 `scripts\package.ps1` 生成到 `SkinMapLocal-dist`。

代码来源基线：`FaceReconstructionLocal` 提交 `bbd50dd`。

## 构建、测试和发布

```powershell
scripts\build.ps1
scripts\test.ps1 -GoldenDirectory "..\27723_1785817898513"
scripts\package.ps1
```

发布包输出到 `SkinMapLocal-dist`，其中不包含源码、厂家 Engine 或真人数据。

## 环境变量

- `SKINMAP_RUNTIME_DIR`
- `SKINMAP_HOST` / `SKINMAP_PORT`
- `SKINMAP_VENDOR_ENGINE_ROOT`
- `SKINMAP_VENDOR_HOST` / `SKINMAP_VENDOR_PORT`
- `SKINMAP_VENDOR_AUTOSTART`
- `SKINMAP_VENDOR_TOTAL_SECONDS`（默认 300；启动、生成、检测共享总预算）
- `SKINMAP_CALIBRATION`
- `SKINMAP_DEVICE_PROFILES`
- `SKINMAP_RESIDUAL_MODEL`

你这次判断是对的。我刚按厂家工程的真实调用链重新核了一遍：当前调试报告确实还是一个“厂家伪彩底图 + 我们旧 Mask/指标”的混合实验，它不能用于判断厂家算法效果，更不能作为后续正式替换依据。

真正的厂家链路是两条并行输出：`/generate` 生成 RED/BROWN/REDNE 风格图，`/detect` 从原始多光谱照片生成厂家的色素、红斑、红血丝等 Mask、定位和指标。正确整合必须让底图、检测 Mask、指标都来自这次厂家运行；我们的代码只负责坐标校验、分区统计和报告排版。这里还有一个会直接决定实施方式的输入问题，我先和你锁定。

questions.question: 本轮重做厂家红棕调试链时，厂家 Exact 应采用哪种输入边界？

options.label: 先做9图Debug (Recommended)
options.description: 使用同会话RGB/CP/365的L/M/R运行真实Exact，正式报告仍不动，先看纯厂家检测效果。

options.label: 正式路线允许9图
options.description: 若调试通过，后续四光源正式路线也允许额外读取L/R，但正式报告仍只展示M正脸。

options.label: 始终只用正脸M
options.description: 保留4张M输入，但不能宣称使用厂家Exact，只能开发和验证正脸原生替代算法。

    @staticmethod
    def _feature_masked_gaussian(
        values: np.ndarray,
        mask: np.ndarray,
        sigma: float,
    ) -> np.ndarray:
        """Gaussian smoothing without allowing black background into statistics."""

        return get_cuda_backend().masked_gaussian(values, mask, sigma)

    def _extract_red_features(
        self,
        redness_score_map: np.ndarray,
        region_masks: dict[str, np.ndarray],
        postprocess_masks: dict[str, np.ndarray],
    ) -> tuple[
        np.ndarray,
        list[dict],
        dict[str, dict[str, float | int]],
        dict[str, object],
    ]:
        """Convert the continuous score into countable compact red features.

        This branch is used only for engineering quantification. It does not
        feed back into any of the five display presets.
        """

        # 延迟导入，确保五档红区视觉主线在量化依赖加载前已经完整计算。
        # 量化是只读分支，不允许改变正式 score map 或五档出图。
        from skimage.feature import peak_local_max
        from skimage.segmentation import watershed

        analysis_mask = np.zeros(redness_score_map.shape, dtype=np.uint8)
        for mask in region_masks.values():
            analysis_mask = cv2.bitwise_or(analysis_mask, mask)
        empty_distribution = {
            name: {"count": 0, "area": 0, "area_ratio": 0.0}
            for name in region_masks
        }
        filter_reasons = {
            "eyes": 0,
            "eyebrows": 0,
            "nostrils": 0,
            "lips": 0,
            "boundary": 0,
            "nasolabial": 0,
        }
        filter_summary: dict[str, object] = {
            "pre_filter_count": 0,
            "filtered_count": 0,
            "reasons": filter_reasons,
        }
        if np.count_nonzero(analysis_mask) < Config.MIN_VALID_MASK_PIXELS:
            return (
                np.zeros_like(analysis_mask),
                [],
                empty_distribution,
                filter_summary,
            )

        final_mask = np.zeros_like(analysis_mask)
        locations: list[dict] = []
        next_id = 1
        analysis_area = max(1, int(np.count_nonzero(analysis_mask)))

        for region_name, raw_region_mask in region_masks.items():
            region_mask = cv2.erode(
                raw_region_mask,
                cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (3, 3)),
            )
            region_values = redness_score_map[region_mask > 0]
            if region_values.size < Config.MIN_VALID_MASK_PIXELS:
                continue
            median = float(np.median(region_values))
            mad = float(np.median(np.abs(region_values - median)))
            robust_sigma = max(1.4826 * mad, 0.025)
            region_threshold = max(
                Config.RED_FEATURE_SCORE_FLOOR,
                float(np.percentile(region_values, 62)),
                median + 0.35 * robust_sigma,
            )
            regional_z = np.maximum(
                (redness_score_map.astype(np.float32) - median)
                / robust_sigma,
                0.0,
            )
            regional_z[region_mask == 0] = 0.0

            peak_candidates: list[tuple[int, int, int, float]] = []
            for scale_index, sigma in enumerate(
                Config.RED_FEATURE_LOCAL_SIGMAS
            ):
                smoothed = self._feature_masked_gaussian(
                    redness_score_map,
                    region_mask,
                    sigma,
                )
                coordinates = peak_local_max(
                    smoothed,
                    labels=(region_mask > 0).astype(np.uint8),
                    min_distance=Config.RED_FEATURE_PEAK_DISTANCE,
                    threshold_abs=region_threshold,
                    exclude_border=False,
                )
                for py, px in coordinates:
                    peak_candidates.append(
                        (
                            int(py),
                            int(px),
                            scale_index,
                            float(smoothed[int(py), int(px)]),
                        )
                    )

            peak_candidates.sort(key=lambda item: item[3], reverse=True)
            clusters: list[dict] = []
            merge_distance_sq = float(
                (Config.RED_FEATURE_PEAK_DISTANCE + 2) ** 2
            )
            for py, px, scale_index, peak_value in peak_candidates:
                match = None
                for cluster in clusters:

from __future__ import annotations

"""Build one debug-only Vendor-base/DermaVision-overlay experiment.

The vendor RED/BROWN/REDNE images are display products.  They are never fed
back into a detector.  Existing DermaVision masks and metrics remain the sole
measurement source; this script only aligns the vendor display products and
draws the already-frozen masks on top of them.

import argparse

CAPTURE_ALIAS = "clinic28-25"

def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _canonical_sha256(value: Any) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")
    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()


def _bounded_file(root: Path, relative: str) -> Path:
    resolved_root = root.resolve(strict=True)
    candidate = (resolved_root / relative).resolve(strict=True)
    if (
        not candidate.is_relative_to(resolved_root)
        or candidate.is_symlink()
        or not candidate.is_file()
    ):
        raise ValueError(f"file escaped fixed root: {relative}")
    return candidate


def _read_image(path: Path, flags: int = cv2.IMREAD_COLOR) -> np.ndarray:
    image = cv2.imdecode(np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.uint8), flags)
    if image is None:
        raise ValueError(f"unable to decode image: {path}")
    return image


def _write_jpeg(path: Path, image: np.ndarray) -> Path:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ok, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", image, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 95])
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(f"unable to encode image: {path}")
    encoded.tofile(path)
    return path


def _fixed_input(fixed_root: Path, role: str) -> Path:
    manifest_path = _bounded_file(fixed_root, "input_manifest.json")
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    matches = [
        row
        for row in manifest["inputs"]
        if row["capture_alias"] == CAPTURE_ALIAS and row["role"] == role
    ]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"fixed input is not unique: {CAPTURE_ALIAS}/{role}")
    row = matches[0]
    path = _bounded_file(fixed_root, row["relative_path"])
    if path.stat().st_size != row["size_bytes"] or _sha256(path) != row["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError(f"fixed input hash drifted: {CAPTURE_ALIAS}/{role}")
    return path


def _head(snapshot: dict[str, Any], module_id: str, head_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    module = next(
        row for row in snapshot["modules"] if row["requirement_id"] == module_id
    )
    return next(row for row in module["evidence_heads"] if row["head_id"] == head_id)


def _artifact(root: Path, head: dict[str, Any], filename: str) -> Path:
    row = next(
        item
        for item in head["artifacts"]
        if Path(item["relative_path"]).name == filename
    )
    path = _bounded_file(root, row["relative_path"])
    if path.stat().st_size != row["size_bytes"] or _sha256(path) != row["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError(f"snapshot artifact drifted: {filename}")
    return path


def _preprocess(path: Path, preprocessor: ImagePreprocessor) -> Any:
    source = _read_image(path)
    result = preprocessor.preprocess_image(source)
    if result.analysis_image.shape[:2] != (ANALYSIS_SIZE, ANALYSIS_SIZE):
        raise ValueError("preprocessor escaped the 1024 analysis space")
    if result.landmarks.shape != (478, 2):
        raise ValueError("expected 478 aligned face landmarks")
    return result


def _align_vendor(path: Path, matrix: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    source = _read_image(path)
    return cv2.warpAffine(
        source,
        matrix,
        (ANALYSIS_SIZE, ANALYSIS_SIZE),
        flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,
        borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT,
        borderValue=(255, 255, 255),
    )


def _overlay_existing_mask(
    vendor_base: np.ndarray,
    mask: np.ndarray,
    preprocessed: Any,
) -> np.ndarray:
    if mask.shape != vendor_base.shape[:2]:
        raise ValueError("mask and vendor base dimensions differ")
    binary = mask > 0
    output = vendor_base.copy()
    marker = np.asarray(VISIA_BOUNDARY_COLOR, dtype=np.float32)
    if np.any(binary):
        output[binary] = np.clip(
            0.18 * output[binary].astype(np.float32) + 0.82 * marker,
            0,
            255,
        ).astype(np.uint8)
        contours, _ = cv2.findContours(
            binary.astype(np.uint8) * 255,
            cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL,
            cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE,
        )
        cv2.drawContours(
            output,
            contours,
            -1,
            VISIA_BOUNDARY_COLOR,
            1,
            lineType=cv2.LINE_AA,
        )
    regions = build_visia_regions(
        preprocessed.analysis_image,
        preprocessed.skin_mask,
        preprocessed.landmarks,
        preprocessed.quality_flags,
        mode="full",
    )
    return draw_region_boundaries(
        output,
        regions.display_regions,
        VISIA_BOUNDARY_COLOR,
        thickness=2,
        partial_face=regions.partial_face,
        closed_contour=regions.display_contour,
        separator_contour=regions.display_separator,
    )


def _comparison(left: np.ndarray, right: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    if left.shape != right.shape:
        raise ValueError("comparison images have different dimensions")
    gap = np.full((left.shape[0], 16, 3), 255, dtype=np.uint8)
    return np.concatenate((left, gap, right), axis=1)


def _add_picture(document: Document, heading: str, text: str, path: Path) -> None:
    document.add_heading(heading, level=2)
    document.add_paragraph(text)
    paragraph = document.add_paragraph()
    paragraph.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    paragraph.add_run().add_picture(str(path), width=Inches(6.4))


def _docx_text(path: Path) -> str:
    document = Document(path)
    paragraphs = [paragraph.text for paragraph in document.paragraphs]
    cells = [
        cell.text
        for table in document.tables
        for row in table.rows
        for cell in row.cells
    ]
    return "\n".join((*paragraphs, *cells))


def _media_hashes(path: Path) -> set[str]:

        return {

    @staticmethod
    def _render_brown(
        image: np.ndarray,
        face_render_mask: np.ndarray,
        person_foreground_mask: np.ndarray,
        statistics_mask: np.ndarray,
    ) -> np.ndarray:
        lab = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2LAB).astype(np.float32)
        l_channel = lab[:, :, 0] / 255.0
        a_channel = (lab[:, :, 1] - 128.0) / 127.0
        b_channel = (lab[:, :, 2] - 128.0) / 127.0
        rgb = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
        rgb_sum = np.maximum(np.sum(rgb, axis=2), 1e-5)
        rgb_brown = rgb[:, :, 0] / rgb_sum - rgb[:, :, 2] / rgb_sum

        # 与老版 R-G 直取法对应的棕色素直取证据。背景和五官均不参与
        # 分位数，避免白背景、眼球或嘴唇把棕色动态范围拉坏。
        raw_brown = (
            Config.RENDER_DARK_WEIGHT * (1.0 - l_channel)
            + Config.RENDER_YELLOW_WEIGHT * np.maximum(b_channel, 0.0)
            + Config.RENDER_RED_BROWN_WEIGHT * np.maximum(a_channel, 0.0)
            + Config.RENDER_RGB_BROWN_WEIGHT * np.maximum(rgb_brown, 0.0)
        )
        valid = raw_brown[statistics_mask > 0]
        if valid.size:
            low, high = np.percentile(
                valid,
                [Config.RENDER_PERCENTILE_LOW, Config.RENDER_PERCENTILE_HIGH],
            )
        else:
            low, high = 0.0, 1.0
        high = max(float(high), float(low) + 1e-6)
        global_norm = np.clip((raw_brown - low) / (high - low), 0.0, 1.0)
        # 连续底图只使用每个前景像素自身的棕色色彩证据。五官遮挡 Mask
        # 不得以任何空间形状混入这里，否则 score 域外的 0 会形成眼周、
        # 唇周或鼻孔周围的规则矩形伪影。``statistics_mask`` 仅用于上面的
        # 稳健分位数取样；30px 五官禁区仅用于后续实例点删除。
        brown_norm = global_norm
        brown_norm = np.power(brown_norm, Config.RENDER_GAMMA)

        # 精确复用旧版 15px 高频增强，恢复棕色斑点和细颗粒，而不是把
        # 整张脸平铺成相同棕色。
        brown_blur = cv2.GaussianBlur(
            brown_norm,
            (Config.RENDER_DETAIL_KERNEL, Config.RENDER_DETAIL_KERNEL),
            0,
        )
        brown_sharp = np.clip(
            brown_norm
            + (brown_norm - brown_blur) * Config.RENDER_DETAIL_BOOST,
            0.0,
            1.0,
        )
        density = 1.0 - np.power(
            np.clip(1.0 - brown_sharp, 0.0, 1.0),
            Config.RENDER_DENSITY_CONTRAST,
        )
        canvas = (
            Config.COLOR_BASE[None, None, :] * (1.0 - density[:, :, None])
            + Config.COLOR_BROWN[None, None, :] * density[:, :, None]
        )

        # 旧版 9px 有符号亮度 DoG：暗纹理向深棕推进，亮纹理向浅底推进。
        gray = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
        gray_blur = cv2.GaussianBlur(
            gray,
            (Config.RENDER_STRUCTURE_KERNEL, Config.RENDER_STRUCTURE_KERNEL),
            0,
        )
        canvas += (
            gray - gray_blur
        )[:, :, None] * Config.RENDER_STRUCTURE_BOOST

        face_alpha = cv2.GaussianBlur(
            (face_render_mask > 0).astype(np.float32), (0, 0), sigmaX=1.5, sigmaY=1.5
        )
        foreground_alpha = cv2.GaussianBlur(
            (person_foreground_mask > 0).astype(np.float32), (0, 0), sigmaX=1.5, sigmaY=1.5
        )
        # 保持 fc92752 的棕区颜色、对比度、纹理和 score 完全不变，只把
        # 同一张已生成的伪彩画布扩展到完整人像前景。背景仍为白色；头发、
        # 耳朵和五官不进入统计，也不使用另一套着色公式。
        result = (
            canvas * foreground_alpha[:, :, None]
            + 255.0 * (1.0 - foreground_alpha[:, :, None])
        )
        return np.clip(result, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

"""Run the embedded vendor skin-map implementation and append its outputs to debug Word.

The archived RED/BROWN/REDNE files are accepted only as optional comparison
references. They are never copied into the runtime output or the report.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np
from docx import Document
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.shared import Inches


OUTPUT_NAMES = (
    "RED_M.jpg",
    "RED_L.jpg",
    "RED_R.jpg",
    "BROWN_M.jpg",
    "BROWN_L.jpg",
    "BROWN_R.jpg",
    "REDNE_M.jpg",
    "REDNE_L.jpg",
    "REDNE_R.jpg",
)
REPORT_IMAGES = (
    ("BROWN_M.jpg", "厂家算法本次生成的 Brown 综合色素图"),
    ("RED_M.jpg", "厂家算法本次生成的 Red 红区图"),
    ("REDNE_M.jpg", "厂家算法本次生成的 RedNE 红褐联合图"),
)


def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _tree_sha256(root: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for path in sorted(item for item in root.rglob("*") if item.is_file()):
        relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix().encode("utf-8")
        digest.update(len(relative).to_bytes(8, "big"))
        digest.update(relative)
        digest.update(bytes.fromhex(_sha256(path)))
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _bounded_file(root: Path, name: str) -> Path:
    resolved_root = root.resolve(strict=True)
    path = (resolved_root / name).resolve(strict=True)
    if not path.is_relative_to(resolved_root) or path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError(f"invalid bounded input: {name}")
    return path


def _compare_images(generated: Path, reference: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    generated_image = cv2.imread(str(generated), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    reference_image = cv2.imread(str(reference), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    if generated_image is None or reference_image is None:
        raise ValueError("comparison image decode failed")
    if generated_image.shape != reference_image.shape:
        return {
            "same_shape": False,
            "generated_shape": list(generated_image.shape),
            "reference_shape": list(reference_image.shape),
        }
    difference = np.abs(generated_image.astype(np.int16) - reference_image.astype(np.int16))
    return {
        "same_shape": True,
        "pixel_component_equal_fraction": float((difference == 0).mean()),
        "mean_absolute_error": float(difference.mean()),
        "max_absolute_error": int(difference.max()),
    }


def _media_hashes(path: Path) -> set[str]:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        return {
            hashlib.sha256(archive.read(name)).hexdigest()
            for name in archive.namelist()
            if name.startswith("word/media/")
        }


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--input-root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--vendor-modules-root", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--vendor-executable", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--source-debug", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--reference-root", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    output_root = args.output.resolve()
    if output_root.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(output_root)
    output_root.mkdir(parents=True, mode=0o700)
    generated_root = output_root / "vendor_runtime_generated"
    generated_root.mkdir(mode=0o700)

    modules_root = args.vendor_modules_root.resolve(strict=True)
    sys.path.insert(0, str(modules_root))
    from core.skin_generate import Enhence_images  # type: ignore[import-not-found]

    input_paths = {
        name: _bounded_file(args.input_root, name)
        for name in ("CP_M.jpg", "CP_L.jpg", "CP_R.jpg")
    }
    images = [cv2.imread(str(input_paths[name]), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR) for name in input_paths]
    if any(image is None for image in images):
        raise ValueError("vendor CP input decode failed")

    vendor_result = Enhence_images(
        images[0],
        images[1],
        images[2],
        str(generated_root),
        ["red", "brown", "hxs"],
    )
    if not isinstance(vendor_result, dict) or vendor_result.get("status") != "sucessful!":
        raise RuntimeError(f"vendor Enhence_images failed: {vendor_result!r}")

    generated_paths = {name: _bounded_file(generated_root, name) for name in OUTPUT_NAMES}
    for name, path in generated_paths.items():
        image = cv2.imread(str(path), cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        if image is None or image.shape[:2] != images[0].shape[:2]:
            raise ValueError(f"invalid generated image: {name}")

    source_debug = args.source_debug.resolve(strict=True)
    output_docx = output_root / "AISIA_clinic28-25_工程调试报告_厂家算法本次运行红棕图.docx"
    document = Document(source_debug)
    original_shapes = len(document.inline_shapes)
    document.add_page_break()
    document.add_heading("厂家红棕生成算法（本次实际运行）", level=1)
    document.add_paragraph(
        "本节图像由厂家 XingerEngine.exe 内嵌的 core.skin_generate.Enhence_images "
        "在本次运行中对同一采集会话 CP_M/CP_L/CP_R 原图生成，不是从图片库复制。"
    )
    document.add_paragraph(
        "本节未使用 DermaVision 的检测 Mask、score map、ROI 或调色器；"
        "仅用于工程调试对比，不进入用户正式版或医生正式版。"
    )
    document.add_paragraph(
        "finding_backend=vendor_skin_generate_runtime；license_status=unknown。"
    )
    for name, caption in REPORT_IMAGES:
        document.add_heading(caption, level=2)
        paragraph = document.add_paragraph()
        paragraph.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        paragraph.add_run().add_picture(str(generated_paths[name]), width=Inches(5.6))
        label = document.add_paragraph(caption)
        label.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    document.save(output_docx)

    reopened = Document(output_docx)
    if len(reopened.inline_shapes) != original_shapes + len(REPORT_IMAGES):
        raise ValueError("debug report did not embed exactly three runtime-generated images")
    document_text = "\n".join(p.text for p in reopened.paragraphs)
    if any(value in document_text for value in ("/home/", "\\\\wsl", "D:\\")):
        raise ValueError("debug report leaked a local absolute path")
    embedded_hashes = _media_hashes(output_docx)
    expected_hashes = {_sha256(generated_paths[name]) for name, _ in REPORT_IMAGES}
    if not expected_hashes.issubset(embedded_hashes):
        raise ValueError("runtime-generated image bytes were not embedded unchanged")

    comparisons: dict[str, object] = {}
    if args.reference_root is not None:
        for name in OUTPUT_NAMES:
            reference = _bounded_file(args.reference_root, name)
            comparisons[name] = _compare_images(generated_paths[name], reference)

    receipt = {
        "schema_version": "vendor_skin_generate_runtime_debug_v1",
        "status": "PASS",
        "actual_vendor_function_executed": True,
        "vendor_function": "core.skin_generate.Enhence_images",
        "vendor_result": vendor_result,
        "report_role": "engineering_debug",
        "formal_reports_modified": False,
        "source_debug_sha256": _sha256(source_debug),
        "vendor_executable": {
            "sha256": _sha256(args.vendor_executable.resolve(strict=True)),
            "size_bytes": args.vendor_executable.stat().st_size,
        },
        "vendor_modules_tree_sha256": _tree_sha256(modules_root),
        "inputs": {
            name: {"sha256": _sha256(path), "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size}
            for name, path in input_paths.items()
        },
        "generated_images": {
            name: {
                "relative_path": path.relative_to(output_root).as_posix(),
                "sha256": _sha256(path),
                "size_bytes": path.stat().st_size,
            }
            for name, path in generated_paths.items()
        },
        "reference_comparisons": comparisons,
        "output_docx": {
            "relative_path": output_docx.relative_to(output_root).as_posix(),
            "sha256": _sha256(output_docx),
            "size_bytes": output_docx.stat().st_size,
        },
        "checks": {
            "reference_images_used_as_inputs": False,
            "dermavision_measurement_inputs_used": False,
            "three_runtime_images_embedded": True,
            "embedded_bytes_match_runtime_outputs": True,
            "absolute_paths_absent": True,
            "debug_only": True,
        },
    }
    receipt_path = output_root / "validation_receipt.json"
    receipt_path.write_text(
        json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    print(json.dumps({
        "output_docx": str(output_docx),
        "output_docx_sha256": _sha256(output_docx),
        "receipt": str(receipt_path),
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
